note: Golden test values for the SPHEREx DR1 all-sky cube (hips5_cube). All numbers were measured on 2026-11-14 with HTTP Range requests; pixel coordinates are 0-based FITS (x = column, y = row; row 0 is the bottom row of the FITS image = the LAST row of the PNG tile).

byte_formulae.pixel: data_offset[hdu] + ((k*512 + y)*512 + x)*4   (4 bytes, big-endian; IMAGE float32, NHITS/FLAGS int32)
byte_formulae.tables: bytes 320898240..320909759 (11520 B) hold HDU4 header+data and HDU5 header+data; SPECTRAL_CHANNELS rows start at 320901120 (102 rows x 28 B); WCS-WAVE row at 320906880 (1224 B)

channels.note: identical bytes in tiles 10226, 7945 and 1023; frame f of the PNG HiPS = plane f of the FITS cube = row f of this table

multirange_example.warning: S3 ignores multi-range headers and answers 200 with the whole 320,909,760-byte object; only send multi-range to the IRSA nginx host. Range header above ~8 kB is rejected with HTTP 400 (9145 chars failed, <= 7000 chars worked).

geometry.algorithm: HEALPix NESTED order 14 (nside 16384) in ICRS; tile = idx14 >> 18; FITS x = (fy mod 512) - 0.5; FITS y = 511.5 - (fx mod 512); see live_cube.md section 4
geometry.png_orientation: PNG column c = FITS x; PNG row r (from top) = 511 - FITS y. PNG corners: top-left = S vertex, top-right = W, bottom-left = E, bottom-right = N. Children in a parent tile: sub-index 0 top-left, 1 bottom-left, 2 top-right, 3 bottom-right (verified: Npix10226 = top-right quadrant of order-4 Npix2556).

jhk_statistics_tile10226.note: cube synthetic J/H/Ks (aperture r = 2.5 px, annulus 5-9 px, RSR-weighted) minus 2MASS, 1243 isolated AAA stars; values in mag

required_targets.note: positions propagated from SIMBAD (epoch 2000) to epoch 2025.85 with proper motion only; aperture r = 2.5 px

wise0855_stack_snr.note: mean of the finite planes in each band; (centre pixel - median of annulus 4..12 px)/robust annulus sigma. The object is detected only beyond ~4 um, at the position propagated with proper motion to 2025-26; the brief's coordinates are its 2010.5 position, 7 cube pixels (125 arcsec) to the east

hips_png.tile_url_template: {base}/Norder{k}/Dir{floor(n/10000)*10000}/Npix{n}.png for frame 0 and .../Npix{n}_{f}.png for f = 1..101; frames 50 and 51 do not exist (HTTP 404)
hips_png.allsky_url_template: {base}/Norder3/Allsky.png (frame 0), {base}/Norder3/Allsky_{f}.png; 1728x1856 RGBA; tile i at column i % 27, row floor(i/27), 64x64 px each
hips_png.png_format: 512x512, 8-bit palette (colour type 3) + tRNS; palette index 0 = transparent (NaN), index i shows grey level i-1
hips_png.transfer: q = round(clip(v, 0, 40)/40*255) with v in MJy/sr, index = lut[q]; lower orders are the mean of 4 children in data space before the transfer

timings_seconds.client_note: measured from a host with ~0.2 s TCP round trip to us-east-1 / IPAC; a US client will be faster
